text:
Type: frosted glass cone pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table or a kitchen counter; dining room, kitchen, hallway
Style: traditional, classic, Scandinavian
Materials: white frosted glass shade, nickel-plated metal fitting and link chain, white cord threaded through the chain
Colors: soft white, brushed silver
Shape: wide shallow cone shade under a cylindrical metal collar, hangs from an open link chain, simple and medium-sized, light visual weight
Feel: soft, homely, timeless, calm
Goes with: white or wood dining tables, nickel accents, pale walls; traditional, farmhouse or classic kitchens

product.name: KROBY
product.description: The height is easy to adjust by using the S-hook or cutting the chain.
